user_query: I need to create a workout playlist to keep me motivated during my exercise sessions. Can you recommend some energetic songs from the Hot 100 Songs chart? Additionally, provide a playlist object for these songs.

TaskList.description: 查询当前Hot 100歌曲榜单，获取多首充满能量的歌曲信息。
根据推荐的歌曲信息，筛选出适合运动的高能量歌曲，准备歌曲详细信息用于播放列表。
生成一个包含推荐歌曲的播放列表对象，方便用户使用或存储。
